sentences: This week I tried an AI writing assistant for my scripts.
It runs on GPT 4 under the hood, and you can tell.
The first drafts were generic, but the outlines were *excellent*.
I now use it to plan, and I still write every line myself.
Try it for structure, not for your voice.
